proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the Isom presheaves are sheaves because the diagonal is representable (two cited lemmas); for descent of objects, the g_i glue uniquely to g : T -> B by fpqc effective epimorphy, the descent datum becomes a cocycle of isomorphisms between the derived pullbacks L pr_i^* E_i, and the simplicial-spaces lemma (via the footnote's Cech fppf hypercovering) descends the complexes since negative Exts vanish; T-perfectness descends by the pseudo-coherence and tor-amplitude descent lemmas, and condition (2) for the descended E follows from the description of the open W (source lines 5498-5563)
